executive_summary: Maven build failed with 2 compilation errors. The first error is a method signature mismatch in TaskController where getUserTasks is called with wrong parameter types (int, int instead of Pageable). The second error is an illegal attempt to override the final name() method in the TaskStatus enum. Both require code corrections to align method signatures and remove the illegal override.

errors.message: method getUserTasks cannot be applied to given types; required: Long,Pageable found: Long,int,int
errors.root_cause: The controller is calling getUserTasks with two int parameters (page and size) but the service interface expects a Pageable object as the second parameter.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskController.java line 45 to create a Pageable object using PageRequest.of(page, size) and pass it to getUserTasks instead of passing int parameters directly. Example: taskService.getUserTasks(userId, PageRequest.of(page, size))

errors.message: name() in TaskStatus cannot override name() in java.lang.Enum; overridden method is final
errors.root_cause: TaskStatus enum is attempting to override the final name() method inherited from java.lang.Enum, which is not allowed in Java.
errors.fix_recommendation: Remove the name() method override from TaskStatus.java. If custom naming is needed, create a separate method with a different name (e.g., getDisplayName() or getCustomName()) instead of overriding the final name() method.
